name: dk-income-tax
description: Danish personal income tax for income year 2026, for residents who are employees or self-employed (selvstændig erhvervsdrivende). Covers AM-bidrag at 8% and the under-18 rule, bundskat 12.01%, kommuneskat and kirkeskat (2026 averages), the new 2026 bands from the personal tax reform: mellemskat 7.5% over DKK 641,200, topskat 7.5% over DKK 777,900 and toptopskat 5% over DKK 2,592,700, personfradrag DKK 54,100, beskæftigelsesfradrag, jobfradrag, senior and single-parent allowances, skatteloft 44.57% and 42%, share income at 27% and 42% over DKK 79,400, business deductions, depreciation, private car, virksomhedsordningen and kapitalafkastordningen, B-skat, årsopgørelse, the 1 July deadline, restskat and skattetillæg. Trigger on: Danish income tax, topskat 2026, mellemskat, toptopskat, AM-bidrag, personfradrag, beskæftigelsesfradrag, B-skat, årsopgørelse, restskat, self-employed tax Denmark.
